description: nRF52840 development board coexisting with the S140 v6 SoftDevice (app at 0x26000)

firmware_generation.interrupts: application vectors start at 0x26000 and remain compatible with the resident S140 layout
firmware_generation.dma: disabled unless an explicitly selected provider owns its channel, interrupt, and buffers
firmware_generation.clock: provider-owned; the generator does not infer frequency or timing bounds
firmware_generation.boot: resident S140 v6 plus bootloader; generated application origin is exactly 0x26000
